title: Retrieval architecture
text: Retrieval augmented generation retrieves relevant evidence before generating a response. A lexical BM25 retriever scores term frequency and inverse document frequency. Source citations make the retrieved evidence traceable. This local demo returns extracts rather than generating answers.

title: Evaluation methods
text: Recall measures how many relevant sources were retrieved. Mean reciprocal rank measures the position of the first relevant result. A small synthetic benchmark is a smoke test, not proof of real-world retrieval quality. Evaluation data must be independent of training and tuning.

title: Local privacy
text: This workbench operates locally without API keys. Documents stay in memory until the local server stops. Do not expose the development server to the public internet. Never treat retrieved text as trusted instructions.

title: معالجة النصوص العربية
text: معالجة اللغة العربية تتطلب تطبيع النص وإزالة التشكيل وتوحيد أشكال الألف. يدعم البحث الكلمات العربية والإنجليزية مع إظهار المصادر. هذا النظام لا يترجم الأسئلة ولا يستخدم نماذج توليدية. البحث المعجمي يعتمد على وجود كلمات مشتركة.

title: Model monitoring
text: Data drift is a change in the input feature distribution. Model quality must be evaluated with labeled outcomes. Population stability index can flag changes but does not prove that accuracy has fallen. Monitoring needs representative reference data and validated alert thresholds.
